base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT p.id,
       DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY psb.port_security_enabled) AS dr
FROM ports p
JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON psb.port_id = p.id
WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
  AND p.device_id = 'da811c75-0f9b-462c-b020-8ea55f6ca7c7'
